T: Last man in New York. Last tin of peaches.
D: A scientist and his German shepherd may be the last people left in New York.
P: Serve the snacks when Robert and Sam go hunting deer in Times Square.
S: from the corn he grows in the park
Corn tortillas cut into wedges, fried at 180C, salted, with a fresh corn and tomato salsa.
Pantry stash grilled peaches and honey

Tinned peach halves grilled cut side down until caramelised, served warm with honey yoghurt, toasted almonds and a pinch of cinnamon. Drain 2 tins peach halves (800g) and pat dry. Heat a griddle pan over high heat, brush with a little butter and grill the peaches cut side down for 4 minutes until charred and caramelised. Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with 2 tbsp honey. Toast 40g flaked almonds in a dry pan for 2 minutes. Serve the warm peaches with the yoghurt, almonds and a dusting of cinnamon.
M: Central Park charred corn chicken bowls
from the corn he grows in the park

Smoky grilled chicken thighs over rice with charred corn, black beans, chilli lime butter, parmesan, avocado and coriander. Toss 800g chicken thighs with 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp cumin, salt and oil. Grill 4 cobs of corn over hot coals for 10 minutes until charred, then grill the chicken 5 minutes a side. Cook 300g rice. Mix 40g soft butter with chilli flakes and lime zest. Cut the corn from the cobs and toss with the butter. Build bowls with rice, sliced chicken, corn, a drained 400g tin black beans, avocado, grated parmesan and coriander.
cut one for Sam, the best dog in New York
Sirloin seared in a hot pan, basted with butter, garlic and thyme, rested and sliced. Keep a plain piece for the dog.
W: rationed sweets in a locked-down house

Creamy baked rice pudding with lemon peel and a nutmeg skin on top, made from what keeps in the pantry, served warm with jam. Heat the oven to 150C. Butter a 1.5 litre baking dish. Stir 100g short grain rice, 60g caster sugar and 1 litre full cream milk together in the dish and add a long strip of lemon peel. Grate nutmeg over the top and dot with 20g butter. Bake 2 to 2.5 hours, stirring once after 30 minutes, until thick and creamy with a golden skin. Rest 10 minutes and serve warm with a spoon of raspberry jam.
K: the bottle Robert keeps in the lab

Bourbon muddled with tinned peach, lemon and mint, shaken hard and poured over crushed ice with a peach slice and mint sprig. Drain a 410g tin of sliced peaches, keeping 60ml of the syrup. Muddle half the peach slices with the syrup, the juice of 1 lemon and 10 mint leaves in a shaker. Add 200ml bourbon and ice and shake 15 seconds. Strain into 4 tumblers packed with crushed ice. Garnish each with a peach slice and a mint sprig.

s.how: Cut 12 corn tortillas into wedges and fry at 180C until crisp, then salt. Char 2 corn cobs and cut off the kernels. Mix with 3 diced tomatoes, chopped coriander and the juice of 2 limes. Serve the salsa in a bowl with the chips.
